'''Melas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[King/Legends|King's]] [[Bouris Ulgo]] forces during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Castle Panteer]] - taken over by [[House Ulgo]] - where he was killed during an assault on the King Ulgo that resulted in the removal of Bouris Ulgo from the throne.
